title: RAG - Migration Act Assistant
description: One of my biggest projects - geting the inspiration as an international student used to struggle with thousands of hours finding piece of information about Migration Act problems. This project leverage RAG technique and introduce a searching structure + algorithm that reduce searh time + embedding resource by more than 10000 times!!! And create a fundamental to be extended to AS MUCH DOCUMENTS AS WE WANT.

title: Tool Calling - AI Agent
description: An AI Agent which integrated 3 tools that can not only chat as normal but can performing calculation, checking weather, and downloading images for user once needed.

title: News Classification
description: A basic NLP projects that crawling 100+ webpages and then classify these pages' content into 4 popular categories. This project fine-tuned a pre-trained RoBERTa model to classify these 4 categories.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo Detection
description: Inspired by 10+ years watching Ronaldo, I have fine-tuned a pre-trained yolov8 model to detect Ronaldo on images

title: Dog-Cat Classification
description: A simple project to classify whether an image is dog or cat. Achieved by fine-tuned a pre-trained VGG-16 model with more than 500 images.

title: LinkedIn Talent Search Agent
description: Inspired through thousand of hours swapping LinkedIn, I have developed an AI-powered system that will automatically search and summarize best matched candidates for a given job description.

title: RAG-Based Resume Insights
description: Leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide intelligent insights and answer questions based on resume content. Interactive chatbot for resume analysis.
